Quality Wagyu
Apr 2025 • Couples
We ordered a plate of high end Wagyu skirt steak and regular beef skirt steak. The high end Wagyu was delicious and tasted much better than the regular skirt steak. Both were really good. There was a big difference in price between the high quality Wagyu and other beef options. We also ordered fries, corn with butter and cheese, white rice and drinks. We really enjoyed cooking the meat at the table and eating quality Wagyu. There is a service button to call the servers to the table. We enjoyed the evening but left hungry. The portions of meat were small. The Wagyu served semi frozen. In order to feel satisfied it would have costs more than we were willing to spend here. It was a nice time but expensive if you like beef.

japanese “korean bbq”
Apr 2018 • Couples
i would describe this place more as a japanese style korean bbq. i have lived in tokyo for a while and this kind of place is not called japanese bbq but a korean bbq joint since japanese prefer beef (and korean bbq is mostly with pork) they replaced it with beef but all the additional salads and dressing is korean style - komchi salads and the dressing. also the side menu at lunch - when i visited - was proper korean style with variations of pibimbap and komchi stew if i recall correctly. be aware that the staff is very inexperienced and when the flames went out of our grill (a common occurance if the beef fat drips to the charcoal) the guy was just watching and doing nothing, while i asked him for ice (which i would normally have on the side in any bbq place in korea or japan)

Good deal but....
Feb 2018 • Family
My wife and I come here at least twice a month (Phu My Hung location). The beef and pork offerings are quite good and very reasonably priced. In other words, a good deal for your money.

But.....the side dishes are, hmmmm, not very good. We have simply stopped ordering them as they are not worth it. And service tends to be a tad slow.....sometimes very slow.

Other than that, I would still recommend this place. Go forth, eat, and enjoy!
